$comment: InMail has NO field consensus layer. The cold-email rubric was derived from two independent authors publishing about the same job; SCAN-0001 found no InMail skill in any of the nine candidate repositories. So this rubric states its provenance per rule in three tiers and does not pretend the third tier exists.

provenance_tiers.platform: An objective limit the platform itself publishes. Not an opinion and not ours.
provenance_tiers.transferred: A rule the FIELD established for cold email, carried across because the job is the same first-touch job on a different surface. The originating authors are named per rule.
provenance_tiers.absent: No field consensus exists for InMail. Recorded as a GAP rather than filled with our own taste.

gap: SCAN-0001 searched nine repositories holding 465 skills between them and found no LinkedIn InMail skill. There is no consensus to derive from, so every craft rule here is TRANSFERRED from cold email and labelled as such. A rule genuinely specific to InMail, such as whether to reference the recipient's profile, has no field position and is deliberately NOT invented here.

rules.rule: The subject line is at most 200 characters. LinkedIn rejects longer.
The body is at most 1900 characters. LinkedIn rejects longer.
Do not open with a throat-clear.

terms: hope this email finds you well
hope this message finds you well

rules.rule: Ruthlessly short. Well inside the platform cap.
